expectedBehavior: Run the chatbot agent as a Spring Boot @AcpAgent that calls Claude through Spring AI's ChatClient (provider autoconfigured from spring-ai-starter-model-anthropic, built on the community acp-spring-boot-starter), with conversation memory keyed by the ACP session id. The demo launches the Spring Boot agent as a subprocess, asks it to write a haiku about debugging code, then in the SAME session asks it to turn that haiku into a limerick. The agent should return a genuine, non-echoed AI-generated response to each prompt, the limerick should clearly be derived from the haiku (demonstrating per-session conversation memory), and each turn should end with stop reason end_turn (the wire value).
requiredOutput: === Module 26: Spring AI Chatbot Agent Demo ===
